metadata.note: 1982 GSX1100SZ: four-stroke inline four, evenly spaced events in the manufacturer's 1-2-4-3 order (99501-37000-01E p58). Stock 4-into-2 with a balance link and two tailpipes; collector pairing and all tube dimensions are acoustic estimates. Equivalent valve diameter is sqrt(2) times the specified 23 mm exhaust valve (p52); open fraction is an unmeasured acoustic estimate. Silencer bodies are approximated by straight pipes, not measured recordings. See docs/road-bikes.md.
